σαββατισμοσ.def: a keeping of the Sabbath, a Sabbath rest.

σαδδουκαιοσ.def: a Sadducee, a member of the aristocratic party among the Jews, from whom the high-priests were almost invariably chosen.

σαλα.def: Sala, the name of two of the ancestors of Jesus.

σαλαμισ.def: Salamis, a city at the eastern end of Cyprus.

σαλευω.def: I shake, excite, disturb in mind, stir up, drive away.

σαλμων.def: Salmon, son of Nahshon and father of Boaz.

σαλμωνη.def: Salmone, a promontory on the east of Crete.

σαλοσ.gloss: the tossing of the sea in a tempest
σαλοσ.def: the tossing of the sea in a tempest; agitation, rolling.

σαλπιγξ.def: a trumpet, the sound of a trumpet.

σαλωμη.def: Salome, wife of Zebedee and mother of James and John, the apostles.

σαμοθρακη.def: Samothrace, an island south of the province of Thrace.

σαμοσ.def: Samos, an island in the Aegean sea off the coast of Asia Minor, near Ephesus and Miletus.

σαμψων.def: Samson, one of the Judges of Israel.

σαπφειρη.def: Sapphira, wife of Ananias, an early Christian.

σαργανη.def: a basket, generally of twisted cords.

σαρδεισ.def: Sardis, an ancient city of Lydia in the province of Asia.

σαρδονυξ.def: sardonyx, a precious stone, white streaked with red.

σαρεπτα.def: Zarephath, a town in the district of Sidon in Phoenicia.

σαρξ.def: flesh, body, human nature, materiality; kindred.

σατον.def: a large measure equal to nearly three English gallons.

σβεννυμι.def: (a) I extinguish, quench, (b) I suppress, thwart.

σεβαζομαι.def: I worship, stand in awe of.

σεβασμα.def: an object of worship or veneration.

σεβαστοσ.def: (official Greek equivalent of Augustus), venerated, august, a title of the Roman emperors; hence secondarily: Augustan, imperial.

σεισμοσ.def: a shaking (as an earthquake); a storm.

σειω.def: I shake; fig: I agitate, stir up.

σημειον.def: a sign, miracle, indication, mark, token.

σιδων.def: Sidon, a great coast city of Phoenicia.

σικαριοσ.def: an assassin, murderer, bandit; one of the Sicarii.

σιλωαμ.def: Siloam, a spring within the walls, in the south-east corner of Jerusalem.

σκηνωμα.def: a tent pitched, a dwelling, tabernacle.

σουσαννα.def: Susannah, a woman of the retinue of Jesus.

σοφια.def: wisdom, insight, skill (human or divine), intelligence.

σπενδω.def: I pour out as a libation.

στεγη.gloss: a flat roof of a house
στεγη.def: a flat roof of a house.

στιγμη.gloss: a point of time, an instant
στιγμη.def: a moment, point of time, an instant.

στιλβω.def: I shine, glisten, flash, am radiant.

στοιβασ.gloss: a bough, branch of a tree
στοιβασ.def: a bough, branch of a tree.

στρατοπεδαρχησ.def: commander of the Roman emperor's body-guard.

στρεβλοω.def: I twist, torture; met: I twist or pervert language.

στυγναζω.def: I am gloomy, have a somber countenance, am shocked.

συγγενησ.def: akin to, related; subst: fellow countryman, kinsman.

συγκαθιζω.gloss: I cause to sit down with, sit down together
συγκαθιζω.def: I cause to sit down with, sit down together.

συγκαλυπτω.gloss: I conceal closely, cover up wholly
συγκαλυπτω.def: I conceal closely, cover up wholly.

συγκατατιθημι.gloss: I give a vote with, assent to
συγκατατιθημι.def: I give a vote with, assent to.

συγκαταψηφιζω.gloss: I am voted or classed with
συγκαταψηφιζω.def: I am voted or classed with.

συγκλειω.def: I enclose, shut in, make subject to.

συγκοινωνεω.def: I am a partaker with, have fellowship with, am an accomplice in.

συγκομιζω.def: I bear away together with, as in carrying away a corpse.

συγκυπτω.def: I am bowed together, bent double.

συγχεω.def: I bewilder, stir up, throw into confusion.

συκαμινοσ.def: a sycamore tree, black mulberry tree.

συμμορφοω.gloss: I bring to the same form with, conform
συμμορφοω.def: I bring to the same form with, conform.

συμπαθεω.gloss: I sympathize with, have compassion on
συμπαθεω.def: I sympathize with, have compassion on.

συμπαραλαμβανω.def: I take along as a companion.

συμπαραμενω.gloss: I remain or continue together with
συμπαραμενω.def: I remain or continue together with.

συμπορευομαι.def: I journey together with; I come together, assemble.

συμφημι.def: I assent to, consent, confess, agree with.

συμφυλετησ.def: one of the same tribe, a fellow country-man.

συμφυω.gloss: I grow at the same time
συμφυω.def: I grow at the same time.

συμφωνεω.def: I agree with, harmonize with, agree together.

συμψηφιζω.def: I compute, reckon up, count together.

συναθλεω.def: I compete together with others, cooperate vigorously with.

συναιρω.def: I compare (settle) accounts, make a reckoning.

συναναμιγνυμι.def: I mingle together with, keep company with.

συνανταω.def: I meet, encounter, fall in with.

συναπαγω.def: I lead away with, carry along with (in good or bad sense according to context); mid: I conform myself willingly to.

συνδουλοσ.def: a fellow slave, fellow servant; of Christians: a fellow worker, colleague.

συνεπιμαρτυρεω.def: I unite in bearing witness, sanction.

συνερχομαι.def: I come or go with, accompany; I come together, assemble.

συνεσισ.def: a putting together in the mind, hence: understanding, practical discernment, intellect.

συνευδοκεω.gloss: I consent, agree, am of one mind with
συνευδοκεω.def: I consent, agree, am of one mind with, am willing.

συνεχω.def: (a) I press together, close, (b) I press on every side, confine, (c) I hold fast, (d) I urge, impel, (e) pass: I am afflicted with (sickness).

συνθλαω.def: I break, break in pieces, crush, shatter.

συνθρυπτω.def: I break in pieces, crush, thoroughly weaken.

συνιστημι.def: I place together, commend, prove, exhibit; instrans: I stand with; I am composed of, cohere.

συνοδια.gloss: a company traveling together, a caravan
συνοδια.def: a company traveling together, a caravan.

συνοιδα.gloss: I know, consider, am privy to
συνοιδα.def: I know, consider, am privy to.

συνοικεω.def: I dwell with, live in wedlock with.

συνομορεω.def: I am contiguous with, am next door to.

συντασσω.def: I arrange with, direct, appoint, prescribe, ordain.

συντελεω.def: I bring to an end, fulfill, accomplish.

συντεμνω.gloss: I cut short, bring to swift accomplishment
συντεμνω.def: I cut short, bring to swift accomplishment, determine, decide.

συντηρεω.gloss: I preserve, keep safe, keep in mind
συντηρεω.def: I preserve, keep safe, keep in mind, keep close.

συντιθημι.def: mid. and pass: I make a compact (agreement) with (together), covenant with, agree.

συντριβω.def: I break by crushing, break in pieces, shatter, crush, bruise.

συντυγχανω.def: I meet with, come to, fall in with.

συντυχη.def: Syntyche, a woman member of the church at Philippi.

συνυποκρινομαι.def: I dissemble with, play a part with.

συνυπουργεω.def: I help together, join in serving.

συροφοινικισσα.def: Syrophoenician, i.e. Phoenician (of Syria, in contrast to Carthage and its territory in North Africa).

συρτισ.def: Syrtis, a quicksand off the coast of North Africa.

συσπαρασσω.gloss: I throw violently on the ground
συσπαρασσω.def: I throw violently on the ground.

συσσωμοσ.def: belonging to the same body; fig: of Jews and Gentiles belonging to the same Church.

συστελλω.def: I contract, shorten, wrap around, swathe.

συστοιχεω.def: I am in the same rank with; I answer to, correspond to.

συστρατιωτησ.def: a fellow soldier (in the Christian faith).

συστροφη.def: a gathering together, riotous concourse, conspiracy.

σφαζω.def: I slay, kill by violence, slaughter, wound mortally.

σφραγιζω.def: I seal, set a seal upon.

σφραγισ.def: a seal, signet ring, the impression of a seal, that which the seal attests, the proof.

σχολη.def: leisure, a school, place where there is leisure.

σωμα.def: body, flesh; the body of the Church.

σωσθενησ.def: Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue at Corinth.

σωτηρια.def: welfare, prosperity, deliverance, preservation, salvation, safety.
